observations.behavior: Adds a paragraph documenting that the Metering/meters API is out of scope for the Zuora connector.
observations.code_quote: Out of scope — the Metering/meters API (`/meters/*`): despite the "Metering/meters endpoints" changelog note, this family exposes no Object Query collection and no plain list-of-meters endpoint. Every path is either an operational action (run/stop/debug a meter, import a definition, truncate or query event stores) or a per-resource fetch (meter summary, run status, audit-trail entries), none of which supports the `updateddate` filter and cursor pagination this source is built on, so there is no incremental table to add.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies connector implementation boundaries and compatibility with the underlying warehouse ingestion strategy.
